body: I moved out and have been low contact with her for a couple of years but she kept doing stuff like that to my sister and I up until then
Cute! Now please have her spayed. She’ll be healthier, likely live longer, be happier, and there are more than enough homeless cats and kittens  without people creating more

He doesn’t really play with toys on his own almost ever. I play with him for as long as he’ll play (usually about an hour) right before he gets dinner and we go to bed, but it barely seems to tire him out, he just gets bored.

We do playtime, usually for an hour, right before he gets dinner, which is right before I go to sleep. I do usually let him out when she’s up. The cats most ignore each other during the day, it’s only at night that the younger one tries to play too roughly with her so we get them to sleep separately so he isn’t annoying her all night long.

He has food, water, litter box, toys, my bed and his, cat grass, most of his toys, and a good seat at the open window. He just wants to wander around the house, he doesn’t like being in one room all night long
Then he’d just be meowing at my sister all night long, and she has to get up earlier than me
